_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 06 동명사 Chapter Test 뒷부분(15~20번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 기본 5과 동명사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: look forward to -ing 등 자주 쓰이는 표현

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.
body: 많은 책을 읽는 것은 나에게 쉽지 않다.

choices.text: Read many books isn’t easy for me.
Read many books aren’t easy for me.
Reading many books isn’t easy for me.
Reading many books aren’t easy for me.
Reading many books be not easy for me.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I look forward to meet her again.
I look forward meeting her again.
I look forward to meeting her again.
I look forward not meeting her again.
I look forward not to meet her again.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 골라 바르게 고쳐 문장을 다시 쓰세요.
body: ⓐ The girl is good at play the piano.
ⓑ They kept laughing at Mia’s joke.
ⓒ It started to snow in the evening.
ⓓ Are you interested in making cookies?
ⓔ Shaking your head usually means saying no.
ⓕ Eating not vegetables is bad for your health.
questions.answer: ⓐ The girl is good at playing the piano.  ⓕ Not eating vegetables is bad for your health.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: They hoped to see a rainbow.
The girl avoids to answer my question.
He stopped working and took a rest.
Thank you for listening to my story.
I waited for Sue, but she forgot to meet me.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Watching comedy movies is fun.
Understanding my brother’s mind was hard.
Mia and I agreed to go to the park by bus.
Take this pill before go to bed tonight.
I don’t mind sitting on the floor instead of the chair.

questions.prompt: 다음은 수호가 자신을 소개하는 글입니다. 주어진 단어를 사용하여 글을 완성하세요.
body: Hi. My name is Suho. I really enjoy (1) ________ (draw) pictures. I am planning (2) ________ (enter) an art contest next month. I try (3) ________ (become) a better artist.
